# FDG9171

> DO report the number of input values successfully processed by an `OperationStatus` method via an `out` parameter.

Framework Design Guidelines, 3rd edition, section 9.12.4 Partial Writes to Buffers and OperationStatus.

## How it is checked

- Check: fdg (partial coverage)
- Diagnostics: FDG9171
- Automatic fix: not applied automatically (the fix can break callers)
- Severity: library warning, application warning, test none
- Status: draft

Message: Report the number of input values processed by '{0}' through an out parameter

The text has no body; the body of FDG9173 gives the expected signature. FDG9171 reports an externally visible method that returns System.Buffers.OperationStatus and has an input buffer (a parameter named source, or else the first one of type ReadOnlySpan<T>, ReadOnlyMemory<T>, ReadOnlySequence<T> or string) when it has no out parameter of an integer type, or only one, whose name ends with Written. A single out parameter with another name is taken to report the input and is not reported. Methods whose input is the state of the instance, overrides and interface implementations are not checked, so coverage is partial. CA1021 (FDG5113) reports the out parameters of an OperationStatus method (probe with SDK 10.0.402), a pattern that requires them. Adding a parameter changes the public signature, so the fix is breaking; there is no code fix.
